messages.content: You identify patterns in complete email texts. Respond with valid JSON.

Please write a BRIEF 15-20 word executive summary of the theme "Software and Device Operations" as it appears in the following examples.
['To keep protecting you, we upgrade your device periodically.', 'Please contact your financial institution to obtain the necessary updates of the Direct Deposit software.', 'Our Technical Unit is performing a scheduled e-Banking software update', 'We ask that you always have the latest antivirus software protection on whichever device you use to access NatWest Online Credit C...', 'Abbey Customer Service would like to inform you that we are currently carrying out a scheduled upgrade of Abbey Security software.', 'Abbey Customer Service would like to inform you that we are currently carrying out a scheduled upgrade of Abbey Security software.', 'Our Technical Department is running a planned On-line Banking software update', 'Our Support Subdivision is running an arranged Internet Banking software update', 'Standard Bank strongly recommends that all customers upgrade their browsers to this new update, regardless of whether they have experienced this bug.', 'Our Technical Subdivision is running an arranged Online Banking software update', 'Please download the form and follow the instructions on your screen.', 'Click here to do reduce size automatically.', 'Abbey Customer Service would like to inform you that we are currently carrying out a scheduled upgrade of Abbey Security software.']

DO NOT write the summary as a third party using terms like "the text examples" or "they discuss", but write the summary from the perspective of the text authors making the points directly.
Please respond ONLY with a valid JSON in the following format:
{
    "summary": "<SUMMARY>"
}

content: {"summary": "We perform scheduled banking software upgrades and device updates, and recommend keeping browsers and antivirus protection current to maintain security and reliable access."}
